hero.description: A life partner and friends in goodness, your community and temple on the map, sacred texts offline, lectures of your lineage, Jyotish and an ad-free market. One account, and the portal is tuned to your lineage.

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.subtitle: VedaMatch is built around a devotee's life, not around a feed. Every service answers a concrete question a Vaishnava has.

devotee.title: For a devotee
devotee.description: Choose your lineage once, and Education, Music and Inspiration show the materials of your acharyas and teachers, with no foreign overlap.

community.title: For a yatra and temple
community.description: A community with verified status: channels and groups, a pin on the map, notices posted on behalf of the yatra, invitations to programs and festivals.

family.title: For a family in goodness
family.description: Dating with a seven-criteria compatibility score, awareness of the spiritual stage, and Guna Milan by classical Jyotish, up to 36 points.

services.title: Services for devotees
services.subtitle: Every service in one account. Each is described as it works for a Vaishnava today, not as a promise.

items.union: A life partner, a friend or a partner in service. A seven-criteria score takes your spiritual stage and goal into account: family, friendship, service, joint projects.
items.chat: Channels and groups of your community, temple and nama-hatta. Verified communities, a map of yatras by city, messaging without leaving for third-party apps.
items.vedabase: Bhagavad-gita and canonical texts with commentaries, verse search and offline reading: a downloaded book opens without a connection.
items.library: Lectures, books and courses tagged by lineage. A devotee sees their own by default, with no manual filters. Anyone can suggest a find.
items.motivation: Daily quotes and materials, source-checked before publication. How much Vaishnava specificity the feed has is up to a slider.
items.astro: Jyotish by the traditional method: birth chart, Moon nakshatra, current dasha, Guna Milan. Formulas do the math; AI only explains it in words.
items.notices: The community board where nothing is for sale: give something away, find hands for a move, share a ride to a festival, invite people to the Sunday program.
items.market: Goods and services in goodness from devotees: a storefront, shops, orders and a chat with the seller, among your own, with no ads.
items.music: Kirtans, bhajans and recordings from programs, tagged with the performer's lineage.
items.work: Vacancies, services and tools for service and business.

lineage.title: Your lineage is your context
lineage.subtitle: Different lineages have different teachers, standards and bodies of material. That is why every Education item and every Music recording is tagged with a lineage, and a devotee sees their own by default.
lineage.note: Only devotees choose a lineage. Seekers and practitioners see the whole catalogue; this division does not apply to them.
lineage.footnote: The directory is open to extension: if your lineage is missing, write to support.

map.title: Communities on the map
map.description: Real points, the same ones portal members see. A pin is a community, the number next to it is how many open talks it has.

howItWorks.title: How to start
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps and the portal is tuned to you

login.title: Sign in with Google
login.description: No passwords and no ten-screen forms. One account opens every service of the platform.

stage.title: Stage of the path and lineage
stage.description: A short questionnaire finds where you are on the path: seeker, practitioner or devotee. A devotee additionally picks a lineage.

portal.title: The portal tuned to you
portal.description: The feed, lectures and recommendations follow your stage and lineage. The advisor on the home page suggests the next step.

principles.title: What the portal stands on
principles.subtitle: Rules that do not change from service to service

noAds.title: No ads
noAds.description: No banners and no paid promotion. Renewing a notice does not lift it in the feed; that is not a way to be first.

moderation.title: Moderation before publication
moderation.description: Quotes, materials and members' finds are checked by an administrator. Sources are verified, not taken from anywhere.

privacy.title: Contacts only by consent
privacy.description: Ways to reach you are never shown in a feed. They open when the other side has agreed to talk.

verified.title: Verified communities
verified.description: Temples, yatras and nama-hattas get a verification mark. A notice on behalf of a yatra is posted only by its owner and admins.

offline.title: Texts without internet
offline.description: Downloaded Library books open offline: on the road, in the temple, at a festival.

onePlan.title: One plan for everything
onePlan.description: No separate fee per service and no quota on what you read. The first month is free.

cta.title: Join the Vaishnavas of the portal
cta.description: Sign in with Google, a short questionnaire, and you are among your own. The first month is free.

meta.title: VedaMatch for Vaishnavas
meta.description: A portal for devotees of every lineage: dating in goodness, communities and temples on the map, Bhagavad-gita offline, lectures of your lineage, Jyotish and an ad-free market. One account, every service.
